_source: V4 business marketing video (brief of 2026-09-29: 'PROGBIZ ERP CRM - FINAL 4-MINUTE BUSINESS MARKETING VIDEO'). Narration is the brief's wording with three corrections: the brand is written 'Progbiz' (lower-case b); page names follow the product ('the AI Assistant', 'CRM Dashboard', 'Executive Performance'); one sentence each was added to AI Call Analysis and WhatsApp naming capabilities confirmed on the live pages (lead score, agent score, sentiment, AI summary, coaching note; broadcasts; chatbot). Pictures come from the existing captures in reports/video/beta/cap (no new visit to the ERP).

sections.title: Introduction
sentences: Running a growing business means keeping track of customers, sales, follow-ups and your team, all at the same time.
But when that information is spread across different places, it becomes difficult to know what is happening, what needs attention, and where your team stands.
Progbiz ERP brings that visibility together in one connected workspace.

sections.title: Home
sentences: Start with a clear view of your business.
Progbiz gives you a quick overview of the information that matters most, helping you understand what is happening today and where attention is needed.

sections.title: AI Assistant
sentences: And when you need answers quickly, the AI Assistant brings important business information closer to you.
With a single interaction, get visibility into lead status, employee work status and attendance, without having to search through multiple areas of the system.

sections.title: Leads
sentences: Every enquiry is an opportunity.
Progbiz keeps your leads organized, giving your sales team a clear view of the customers and opportunities they need to work on.
With the right information available at the right time, your team can focus less on searching, and more on engaging customers.

sections.title: CRM Dashboard
sentences: For managers, the CRM Dashboard turns individual opportunities into a bigger picture.
See lead distribution, pipeline activity and key sales indicators at a glance, helping you understand where the business stands.

sections.title: Executive Performance
sentences: Business visibility also means knowing how your team is performing.
Executive Performance gives managers a clearer view of activity across executives, helping you understand individual progress, and where attention may be needed.

sections.title: AI Call Analysis
sentences: Customer conversations contain valuable information.
With AI Call Analysis, conversations can become useful business insights, helping teams understand customer interactions and giving managers better visibility into call activity.
See a lead score, an agent score and the customer's sentiment for every call, with a short AI summary and a coaching note.

sections.title: Follow-ups
sentences: A lead is valuable only when the next action happens.
Progbiz keeps follow-up activity visible, showing what needs attention today, what has been delayed, and what is coming next.
So your team can stay consistent, and important customer conversations don't get lost.

sections.title: Lead Transfer
sentences: Business priorities can change.
When an opportunity needs a different executive, Progbiz makes it easier to transfer the lead to the right person, and keep the sales process moving.

sections.title: WhatsApp
sentences: Customer communication should be simple, and connected to the sales process.
With WhatsApp integrated into the workflow, your team can communicate with customers faster, keep conversations connected to business activity, and make follow-up communication more convenient.
Reach many customers at once with broadcasts, while a chatbot welcomes new enquiries, day and night.

sections.title: Closing
sentences: From your business overview to leads, team activity, AI insights, follow-ups and customer communication, Progbiz keeps your workflow connected.
One platform.
Clearer visibility.
Better control.
Progbiz ERP.

end_card.title: PROGBIZ ERP
end_card.cta: One connected workspace for your business.
